newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares storm higher, seen holding.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares storm higher, seen holding.

text.p: Austrian shares made a determined push on the upside on Wednesday, breaking key resistance levels amid strong buying interest in selected shares to close at its highest level in 13 weeks.
The blue-chip ATX index shrugged off mild downward pressure early in the session, climbing 10.58 points or 0.99 percent to an intraday high of 1,084.46, before easing to close at 1,081.21.
Among its constituents, 16 gainers outnumbered five losers.
The index was expected to sustain its gains in the short term, although a drop back to 1,075 would not be a disaster, traders said.
"I don't think we will see it reach 1,100 in one go," one said.
Dealers said good demand for regional utility EVN and engineering group VA Technologie had bolstered the rest of the index.
"There is money once again in the Vienna market," one said.
The leading gainer of the session was EVN, which jumped 5.30 percent to 1,470 schillings.
Bank Austria was the session's biggest decliner, shedding 1.22 percent to 419.8 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index rose 2.2 points or 0.54 percent to 414.76.
On the Vienna futures and options exchange, ATX futures for October delivery rose 6.3 points to 1,079.00.
